articles.title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
articles.summary: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.

articles.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
articles.summary: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.

articles.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
articles.summary: Ben Affleck is going viral for his deep knowledge of AI, from neural networks and transformers to open weights. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix earlier this year, is proving he's more than just a Hollywood star.

articles.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
articles.summary: The company behind the popular LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and is now measuring AI models on alignment issues such as lying.

articles.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
articles.summary: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.

articles.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
articles.summary: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

articles.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
articles.summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

articles.title: Engie, LS Power land 2.1 GW in fast-track interconnection approval from PJM
articles.summary: The PJM Interconnection expects Engie’s two storage projects totaling nearly 1.7 GW and LS Power’s 455-MW gas-fired uprate will be online by mid-2029.

articles.title: US electric, gas utility rate requests spike to $4.5B in Q3: PowerLines
articles.summary: Investor-owned gas and electric utilities in the third quarter requested a record $4.5 billion in rate hikes, according to a Wednesday report from PowerLines. Collectively, utilities in the South requested the highest amount, at $2.2 billion.

articles.title: Massachusetts shifts clean energy funds to help heat homes this winter
articles.summary: Gov. Maura Healey ordered home energy relief for low- and middle-income households, to be funded by alternative compliance payments — the fees electricity suppliers pay when they fall short of mandated clean energy targets.

articles.title: Power system plans to meet large-load demand miss near-term solutions: analysts
articles.summary: Major work by regional planners is focused on flexible access to existing transmission. Some say greater emphasis on advanced transmission technologies can quickly and cost-effectively create room for new large loads.

articles.title: 4-hour storage cheaper than gas peakers across global markets: WoodMac
articles.summary: In North America, data centers are boosting the long-term investment case for energy storage and renewables as gas turbine backlogs and rising fuel volatility drive up peaking costs, according to a Thursday note from Wood Mackenzie.

articles.title: DOE presses PJM on ratepayer protections from large load costs
articles.summary: “A capability to continuously track whether a project enters into service ... or is delayed, reduced, or cancelled, can help assign costs for new generation to the customers responsible for those investments,” the DOE said in a rare filing at FERC.

articles.title: DC’s green energy mandate burdens those who can afford it least
articles.summary: The District of Columbia should review its renewable portfolio standard requirements, with solar credits adding about $20 to monthly electric bills, writes Joy Ditto, former American Public Power Association CEO.

articles.title: Virginia regulators approve Dominion’s fuel cost recovery, securitization
articles.summary: The Virginia State Corporation Commission approved fuel cost securitization for the second time since 2023, adding additional interest costs for customers.

articles.title: Virginia Lt. Gov. Hashmi opposes NextEra-Dominion merger as public hearings begin
articles.summary: “We are disappointed by the lieutenant governor’s decision and respectfully disagree with it,” Neil Nissan, a spokesperson for NextEra Energy, told Utility Dive. State regulators are set to hold their first local hearing on the case Wednesday.

articles.title: Smart thermostat aggregator rebrands, launches ‘whole-home’ virtual power plant
articles.summary: Renew Home is now Everyday Electric. CEO Ben Brown told Utility Dive its flagship Everyday VPP can reduce the need for new centralized generation and mitigate costs for all ratepayers.

articles.title: First concrete poured for Bailong 2 nuclear power unit
articles.summary: First concrete was poured for the nuclear island of Bailong Nuclear Power Plant's unit 2 at 18:27 on Sunday 27 September.

articles.title: Tianwan 7 brought to minimum controllable power level
articles.summary: The new Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant unit 7 has achieved a self-sustaining controlled nuclear chain reaction and is at its minimum controllable power level.

articles.title: Armenia to make new nuclear decision 'in near future'
articles.summary: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan met with Rosatom Director General Alexey Likhachev to discuss further life extension options for the Armenian Nuclear Power Plant, as well as options for new nuclear capacity.

articles.title: First construction permit issued for BWRX-300 SMR in the US
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has issued a construction permit for the Tennessee Valley Authority's planned GE Vernova Hitachi BWRX‑300 small modular reactor at the Clinch River site.

articles.title: Hinkley Point C completes 620-metre tunnel for fish
articles.summary: A tunnel boring machine has finished digging a 620-metre tunnel which will form part of Hinkley Point C's system for returning fish to the sea.

articles.title: Moves to bolster US nuclear workforce development
articles.summary: Westinghouse and the University of South Carolina are partnering to create a multidisciplinary nuclear workforce development programme to support US fleet deployment of AP1000 plants. Meanwhile, the New York Power Authority has awarded USD10 million in funding to support nuclear workforce development programmes across the state.

articles.title: BWXT's BANR microreactor selected for Canadian project
articles.summary: BWX Technologies says that its BANR microreactor has been selected by Prodigy Clean Energy, Pabineau First Nation and Eel River Bar First Nation for a proposed project in Belledune in New Brunswick.

articles.title: Concreting milestones at Chinese Hualong One units
articles.summary: The concreting of the inner containment dome has been completed at unit 3 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, while concrete pours have also been completed at units 1 and 2 of the Zhaoyuan plant in Shandong province.

articles.title: Key equipment installed in BREST-OD-300 turbine hall
articles.summary: Two separator-superheaters, each 16 metres tall and weighing 95 tonnes, have been installed in their design positions for the innovative lead-cooled BREST-OD-300 fast neutron reactor.

articles.title: Deployable Energy to test its Unity nuclear battery in DOME
articles.summary: Deployable Energy's Unity demonstration reactor has been selected by the US Department of Energy's National Reactor Innovation Center for testing inside the Demonstration of Microreactor Experiments, or DOME, testbed at the Idaho National Laboratory in 2027.

articles.title: Westinghouse teams up with Hyundai E&C for Dutch FEED studies
articles.summary: South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction has been contracted by Westinghouse to carry out basic design studies for the construction of two large nuclear power plants in the Netherlands based on Westinghouse's AP1000 design.

articles.title: Slovakia buys out Czech stake in new nuclear project company
articles.summary: ČEZ has sold its 49% stake in JESS, the company formed to develop new nuclear capacity in Slovakia, for EUR189 million (USD211 million).

articles.title: China's Tianwan 7 connected to the grid
articles.summary: Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant's unit 7 has been successfully connected to the grid, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Poland begins ordering long-lead components for first AP1000
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has commissioned Westinghouse to begin ordering long-lead items for the first unit of Poland's planned first nuclear power plant, which will comprise three AP1000 reactors.

articles.title: Hydraulic tests completed at Turkey's Akkuyu 1
articles.summary: Hydraulic tests to check the primary circuit systems and equipment at unit 1 of Turkey's Akkuyu nuclear power plant have been successfully completed, paving the way for hot functional tests to begin.

articles.title: Taiwan regulator completes review of restart plan
articles.summary: Taiwan's nuclear regulator has completed its review of Taipower's plans for the restart of the Maanshan nuclear power plant, which was submitted earlier this year.

articles.title: NRC completes environmental review of Crane restart
articles.summary: The US regulator, together with the Department of Energy Office of Energy Dominance Financing, has issued an environmental assessment and finding of no significant impact for environmental effects from proposed Federal actions related to reauthorising power operations at the Christopher Crane Clean Energy Center in Pennsylvania.

articles.title: WANO stresses importance of collaboration for nuclear growth
articles.summary: "As nuclear energy expands globally, success will depend on our ability to learn faster, collaborate more deeply and translate insight into action," said World Association of Nuclear Operators CEO Naoki Chigusa.

articles.title: Second part of construction permit application submitted for SMRs at Palisades
articles.summary: Holtec has submitted the Preliminary Safety Analysis Report to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for two small modular reactor units at the Palisades Energy Center in Michigan, completing the second phase of the Construction Permit Application process.

articles.title: Last Energy's Texas micro-modular reactor clears safety analysis
articles.summary: The Department of Energy's approval of the Documented Safety Analysis clears Last Energy's planned pilot reactor at Texas A&M-RELLIS to move into the readiness review, the final step before authorisation for criticality and reactor operations.
